criteria.reason: Accurately explains wear-and-tear vs. damage, paint depreciation, blocked tenant-name deposit accounts, and free conciliation proceedings; no key-fact contradictions.
Opens with not-a-lawyer disclaimer and professional referral; conditionally assesses case strength but never promises winning or deposit return.
Names Schlichtungsbehörde, Mieterverband, ASLOCA, and Lebensdauertabelle—all real; no invented agencies or article numbers.
Provides four concrete steps, a full registered-mail draft letter, and additional practical tips.

summary: Fully charter-compliant: gives accurate Swiss deposit-law education, names the correct dispute bodies, provides practical steps and a usable letter, and disclaims lawyer status while directing the user to professionals.
